metadata.description: Marketplace for the harbor plugin (set up Python simulation repos with uv and author RL tasks end-to-end).

plugins.name: harbor
plugins.description: Set up Python simulation repos with uv, scaffold the RL stack (train / eval / render / sweep / tune), and author tasks end-to-end (scene → actions → reset → termination → observation → reward), with every stage gated by an executable check. Includes the dependency, benchmark, rl-integration, task and reward generator subagents and lifecycle hooks.
